entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:1
segments: The Song of songs, which is Solomon's.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; For thy love is better than wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: Thine oils have a goodly fragrance; Thy name is [as] oil poured forth; Therefore do the virgins love thee.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Draw me; we will run after thee: The king hath brought me into his chambers; We will be glad and rejoice in thee; We will make mention of thy love more than of wine: Rightly do they love thee.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I am black, but comely, Oh ye daughters of Jerusalem, As the tents of Kedar, As the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Look not upon me, because I am swarthy, Because the sun hath scorched me. My mother's sons were incensed against me; They made me keeper of the vineyards; [But] mine own vineyard have I not kept.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, Where thou feedest [thy flock], Where thou makest [it] to rest at noon: For why should I be as one that is veiled Beside the flocks of thy companions?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, Go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, And feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: I have compared thee, O my love, To a steed in Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Thy cheeks are comely with plaits [of hair], Thy neck with strings of jewels.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: We will make thee plaits of gold With studs of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: While the king sat at his table, My spikenard sent forth its fragrance.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: My beloved is unto me [as] a bundle of myrrh, That lieth betwixt my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My beloved is unto me [as] a cluster of henna-flowers In the vineyards of En-gedi.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: Behold, thou art fair, my love; Behold thou art fair; Thine eyes are [as] doves.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: Also our couch is green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: The beams of our house are cedars, [And] our rafters are firs.
